login_pitch_shelf_f1_body: Ebitabo, obubaka, enteekateeka n’ebijuliziddwa mu tterekero limu.
login_pitch_notebook_title: Buli lunyiriri olwakukwatako, nga lukuŋŋaanyiziddwa wamu.
login_pitch_notebook_lede: Ssaako langi ku kitundu ng’osoma era owandiike ebirowoozo byo ku mabbali gaakyo. Ebijjukizo byo bikuuma buli kitundu kya langi, buli kijjukizo ne buli kabonero wamu, nga bisengekeddwa okusinziira ku kitabo, oddeyo ku ekyo ekyakwogerako.

login_pitch_notebook_f3_body: Noonya buli kimu, okusinziira ku kitabo, ku buli kyuma.
login_pitch_sample_quote: Obwetoowaze, ekifo eky'okwesigama kwonna ku Katonda, mu butonde bw'ebintu bwennyini, [[bwe mulimu ogusooka era empisa esinga obulungi ey'ekitonde]], era bwe muzi gwa buli mpisa ennungi.
about_meta_description: Ochorus kitongole ky'obuweereza ekiri mu Victoria BC, Canada, ne Kampala, Uganda, ekifulumya ebitabo by'Ekikristaayo eby'edda okusomebwa ku yintaneti awatali kusasula, era ne kitwala ebitabo ebikube mu Afirika ey'Ebuvanjuba.
about_p1: Ng’esangibwa mu Victoria BC, Canada ne Kampala, Uganda, Ochorus buweereza obwewaddeyo obulina omulimu omukulu: okuwa ebitabo n’ebintu eby’Ekikristaayo eby’edda ebisingayo obulungi awatali kusasula, eri abasomi buli wamu.
about_p2: Yatandikibwa mu 2021, Ochorus ekubirizibwa okwewaayo okutakyukakyuka okusaasaanya enjiri mu buli nsonda y’ensi, nga ekakasa nti etuukirika mu nnimi n’ebyuma bingi.
about_p3: Nga tutegeera amaanyi g’ebitabo ag’okukyusa, tuzuula ebitabo eby’Ekikristaayo ebirungi ebya bonna (ebitakyalina nnannyini ddembe), ne tubitegeka n’obwegendereza busomeke bulungi, ne tubifulumya ku mukutu guno — okusoma tewali kusasula era n’okukuuma tewali kusasula.
about_p4: Nga tukwatagana n’okwagala kwa Katonda okw’obulokozi bw’abantu bonna, kye twegomba ennyo kwe kuyamba mu kigendererwa kino eky’obwakatonda, abangi basome, balowooze, era bakyusibwe.
footer_mission: Ebitabo by'Ekikristaayo eby'edda ku yintaneti awatali kusasula — n'ebitabo ebikube bye tugaba mu nkuŋŋaana, amakanisa, amasomero, n'amakomera mu Afirika ey'Ebuvanjuba.
about_outreach_heading: Okuva ku Lupapula okutuuka mu Nnimiro
about_outreach_p1: Ochorus si mukutu gwa yintaneti gwokka. Mu Afirika ey'Ebuvanjuba yonna tuteeka ebitabo by'Ekikristaayo ebikube mu mikono gy'abantu — mu nkuŋŋaana z'abasumba abakulembeze b'amakanisa gye bakuŋŋaanira, ne mu makanisa, amasomero, n'amakomera gye tuyitibwa okuweereza.
about_outreach_p2: Ebitabo ebikubidwa mu Uganda bitambula okutuuka mu nkuŋŋaana mu kitundu kyonna, nga biwa amaanyi abasumba ababitwala eka eri ebibiina byabwe. Ebitabo bye bimu bye osoma wano bigabibwa bwereere — eri omuyizi, omusibe, omukkiriza omuggya — kubanga ekigambo kya Katonda tekisibibwa.
about_scripture1: Bwe kityo bwe kinaabeeranga ekigambo kyange ekiva mu kamwa kange; tekiridda gye ndi nga tekigasse, naye kinaakolanga bye njagala, era kinaalaba omukisa mu ekyo kye nkituma.
about_scripture2: Nnali mulwadde ne mujja okundaba; nnali mu kkomera ne mujja gye ndi.
about_scripture3: Ekigambo kya Kristo kibeere mu mmwe mu bujjuvu; nga muyigirizagana era nga mubuulirirangana mu magezi gonna.
about_hero_meta: Victoria, Canada · Kampala, Uganda · Okuva mu 2021
about_hero_alt: Abakkiriza bayimusizza ebitabo bya Ochorus ebiggya ku lukuŋŋaana lw’Ekkanisa mu Uganda
about_vision_quote: Okuwa Ekkanisa mu nsi yonna ebitabo ebikulu eby’edda eby’okukkiriza kw’Abakristaayo nga bya bwereere — mu nnimi zaabwe ze zennyini, olw’ekitiibwa kya Katonda.
about_pillar1_body: Ekitabo kyonna kya Ochorus kisomeka bwa bwereere era kikwatibwa bwa bwereere — tewali akawunti, tewali kusasula, tewali muwendo.
about_pillar2_body: Buli kitabo kiba n’enkyusa yaakyo mu buli lulimi, omusomi n’asisinkana ebigambo mu lulimi lwe lwennyini — so si kuvvuunula kwa makina okusembayo.
about_pillar3_body: Tetukoma ku kukuba bifaananyi bya mpapula n’okubiteeka ku mukutu. Buli kitabo eky’edda tukitereeza ne tukiteeka mu nnukuta ennungi ezisomeka obulungi — era tuwandiika ne tufulumya n’ebitabo bipya ebyaffe.
about_stats_intro: Ekyatandikira nga mukutu gwa yintaneti, kaakano kifuuse layibulale n’omulimu gw’okukuba ebitabo — ebisomebwa mu nsi yonna era ebigabulwa mu nkumi mu Afirika ey’Ebuvanjuba.
about_cap_handover: Ekitabo nga kiteekeddwa mu mikono gy’omusomi ku lukuŋŋaana lw’Ekkanisa.
about_cap_school: Abayizi bakuŋŋaanira ku ssomero lye twayitibwa okuweereza.
about_cap_soar: Omusumba Omunnayuganda ne kkopi ye eya Soar Like the Eagle, eyawandiikibwa Gareth Evans.
about_cap_murray: Abakulembeze b’Ekkanisa ne The Inner Chamber ekya Andrew Murray.
about_cap_gate: Good Samaritan High School, Nansana — limu ku masomero ge tuweereza.
about_cap_matugga: Omukulu w’essomero e Matugga Hills ng’akwata Walking with God in Academics.
about_cap_teacher: Omusomesa afuna ebitabo bya Ochorus olw’essomero lye.
about_cap_staff: Abakozi nga balina ebitabo ebyaweebwayo, nga mwe muli Feasting at the Table.
about_feature_p1: Okugatta ku bitabo eby’edda ebitali bya muntu yenna, ekibinja kyaffe kiwandiika era kikuba ebitabo bipya — nga Walking with God in Academics, ekyawandiikirwa abayizi, ne Soar Like the Eagle ekya Gareth Evans.
about_feature_p2: Ebikubiddwa mu Uganda, ebitabo bino bitambula okutuuka ku nkuŋŋaana mu kitundu kyonna, nga bitegeka abasumba n’abavubuka ababitwala eka mu bibiina byabwe eby’okusinza, mu bibiina by’okuyiga, ne mu maka gaabwe.
about_feature_alt_box: Akasanduuko akajjudde emikanda emiggya egy’okukubibwa egya Walking with God in Academics
about_feature_alt_cover: Omukono gukwata ekitabo ekyakubibwa ekya Walking with God in Academics ekya Ochorus Ministries
about_feature_alt_interior: Olupapula lw’omunda olw’essuula ya Walking with God in Academics
about_partner_heading: Bitwalibwa Mikwano Abeesigwa Awo Ku Ttaka
about_partner_body: Omulimu gwaffe mu Afirika ey'Ebuvanjuba gutambula nga guyita mu bakolagana ab’omu kitundu abeesigwa — mulimu The Uganda Partnership Society, ekibiina eky’Abakristaayo ekyagatta Ekkanisa za Canada n’emirimu gy’obuweereza mu Uganda mu by’okuyiga, okulabirira abaana, n’okukulaakulanya eby’omwoyo okuva mu 2008. Abantu baabwe be baggulawo enzigi; ebitabo byaffe bye biyita mu zo.
about_cta_heading: Ekitabo Kyonna Eky’edda. Olulimi Lwonna. Bwereere.
about_cta_body: Ggulawo layibulale otandike — oba tukwatagane, tubeere bakolagana mu mulimu guno mu kukuba ebitabo ne mu kusaba.
legal_meta_description: Engeri Ochorus gy'ekwatamu eby'ekyama byo n'ebiragiro by'okukozesa etterekero: soma bwereere awatali akawunti, awatali birango, awatali kukulondoola, era n'obuyinza obujjuvu ku data yo ey'okusoma.
legal_intro: Ochorus mulimu gwa bwereere ogufulumya ebitabo by'Ekikristaayo eby'edda okusomebwa ku yintaneti era nga gugaba ebitabo ebikube mu Afirika ey'Ebuvanjuba. Olupapula luno lunnyonnyola, mu ngeri ennyangu, engeri gye tukwatamu amawulire go n'ebiragiro eby'okukozesa omukutu.
legal_privacy_p1: Osobola okusoma etterekero lyonna awatali akawunti. Bw'otoyingira, by'oyagala n'ebikwata ku kusoma kwo — w'otuuse mu kitabo, ebitundu bya langi, ebijjukizo, obubonero, n'ennaku ze wasoma — bisigala mu bbulawuza yo ku kyuma kino era tebituweebwa ffe.
legal_privacy_p2: Bw'okola akawunti, tutereka endagiriro yo eya email (nga tuyita mu abo abatuyamba mu kuyingira) era tugatta ebikwata ku kusoma kwo ku akawunti yo, osobole okusoma ku ssimu ne ku kompyuta yo. Eyo y'ensonga yokka lwe tugikwatirira.
legal_privacy_p3: Tetutunda bikwata ku ggwe, tetulaga birango, era tetukozesa bikessi bya birango wadde eby'emikutu egy'enjawulo. Tetukozesa kkuki eziketta, era tetukuŋŋaanya email yo lwa katale.
legal_privacy_p4: Twesigama ku bawa obuweereza babiri okutambuza omukutu: Supabase (okuyingira n'etterekero ly'ebikwata) ne Render (okusigaza omukutu). Ebikwata ku ggwe biterekebwa gye bali ku lwaffe.
legal_privacy_p5: Ggwe oli mu buyinza: osobola okuwanula oba okusangula ebikwata ku kusoma kwo ekiseera kyonna mu Nsengeka, era okusangula akawunti yo kiggyawo ebikwata bye tukukuumira.
legal_terms_p1: Etterekero lya bwereere okusoma n'okukuuma. Ebitabo ebisinga bya bonna (tebikyalina nnannyini ddembe); ebitabo n'enkyusa za Ochorus zennyini ziweebwa lwa kusoma kw'omuntu ku bubwe, si kwa busuubuzi.
legal_terms_p2: Enkyusa ezimu zikolebwa nga ziyambibwako AI era ziragibwa bulungi nti zirinda okwekebejjebwa abazaaliranwa. Tusaba otwale enkyusa etannaakebejjebwa ng'omulimu ogukyagenda mu maaso, si nkomerero.
legal_terms_p3: Omukutu guweebwa nga bwe guli, awatali bukakafu. Tufuba nnyo okugukuuma nga gwa mazima era nga gukolawo, naye tetuyinza kukakasa nti bulijjo tegujja kubaamu nsobi oba nti tegujja kusalibwako.
legal_terms_p4: Tusaba okozese Ochorus olw'ekigendererwa kyayo — okusoma n'okugabana ebitabo by'Ekikristaayo — era togezaako kutaataaganya oba kukozesa bubi buweereza.
legal_terms_p5: Tuyinza okukyusa olupapula luno oluusi n’oluusi; olunaku oluli wansi lulaga we lwakyusibwa okusembayo.

originals_title: Ebitabo ebipya, ebiwandiikiddwa wamu n’ebitabo eby’edda
originals_lede: Ebitabo ebisinga mu tterekero lyaffe bya myaka bikumi na bikumi. Ochorus Originals bye bitabo bye tuwandiika ffe bennyini: okufumiitiriza okwa buli lunaku eri abaana, emboozi ez’amazima ez’abasajja n’abakazi abaatwala enjiri, n’okuyita okusaba eri abakulembera. Nga buli kimu wano, buli kimu kisomebwa bwereere.
originals_why_body: Ebitabo eby’edda byogera olulimi lw’ekyasa kyabyo. Ochorus Originals biddamu okunyumya obulamu n’amazima ago eri omwana ng’agenda kwebaka, omuyizi ng’agenda kukola bigezo, oba omusumba ku Ssande ekiro — nga biggyibwa mu nsibuko ze zimu ezijjuza etterekero lyonna.
originals_langs_body: Ebimu ku bitabo bya Ochorus byavvuunulwa. Londa olulimi olabe ekisenge kyalwo.
